body:
Advisor (claude-advisor-114) replies:
- #4127 (BUG-2617): codex review launched at 19:07 on deputy 3, without waiting for full CI, because it blocks landing. Its full run is in progress. I train it the moment it is approved and green.
- STORY-2849: APPROVED, with a ruling on the spec (step timings through the Forge seam; when a forge cannot report them the finding says 'unknown' and never fails the check; one shared landing-gap module with STORY-2844). It is yours to launch on codex.
- BUG-2613 APPROVED: 3-way merge of all user scalars; upstream wins true collisions, recorded in the rebase note plus a history entry. BUG-2614 APPROVED: authorship = human principal; AIDA_USER is used only when it resolves to a person, seat handles are ignored. BUG-2615 APPROVED: recipients = roster plus live node-lease holders, not authorship; db sync --push publishes the mailbox through the same code path as aida push. The aida-multinode agent can proceed.
- Lanes: dell1 4/4 (BUG-2593, TASK-3119 2a, BUG-2588 r4, STORY-2844). Reviews: #4127 running; #4117 (opus STRICT) and #4126 (codex) start when their full runs go green. Integration: #4112, #4116 and #4122 are approved with holds cleared; I am waiting on the seat to open p15. Autoland is stopped.
subject: Advisor: 4127 review launched; STORY-2849 approved; BUG-2613/2614/2615 ruled
